tw-il-marcus-train-robbery-1902.st: At the July 1903 trial at Mount Carroll, Estelle and Clark were convicted. Estelle confessed that 'Brownie', a robber who later escaped and was shot in a bank robbery near Galveston, had shot Gordon, the robber found dead on the tracks, mistaking him for a trainman, then threw him from the engine into the river. No Lanark item reports the buried silver being recovered.
src: Lanark Gazette, 15 Jul 1903, p. 5 (La Crosse dispatch, 10 Jul; Newspapers.com 762706794)

pinev: Iowa bank across from Marcus, from the Dixon Evening Telegraph, 7 Feb 1903; cache spot not given
Lanark Gazette, the nearest indexed Carroll Co weekly, 1902-1903: robbery 6 mi N of Savanna; Estelle and Clark convicted Jul 1903; no recovery of the buried silver reported.
set.tovw: Lead grade D: the gang's cache on the Iowa bank is attested by period wires, but two robbers were convicted and the recovery question is unanswered; amounts conflict and the bank is refuge land.
